ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the picture there are two large squares divided into 2×2, with an equals sign in the middle. The upper-left small square of the figure on the left is black, and the rest are white; the lower-right small square of the figure on the right is black, and the rest are white. They can be obtained from each other through rotation, so the picture illustrates that colored patterns after rotation count as the same kind. Reasoning: A 2×2 grid has a total of 4 small squares, and each small square can be chosen as black or white. Considering only rotation equivalence, use Burnside's lemma to calculate the number of different colorings under the rotation group. The rotation group has 4 elements: no rotation, rotation 90°, rotation 180°, rotation 270°. No rotation fixes all colorings, a total of 2^4 = 16 kinds. When it remains unchanged after rotation 90°, the 4 small squares must all be the same color, so there are 2 kinds. When it remains unchanged after rotation 180°, diagonal positions must be the same, and there are two groups of diagonal positions whose colors can be freely chosen, so there are 2^2 = 4 kinds. Rotation 270° is the same reasoning as rotation 90°, and there are also only 2 kinds. Therefore the number of different colorings is (16 + 2 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 6.

method.method_draft: Use Burnside's lemma on the 2x2 grid. First read the image as showing a 2-by-2 square grid and an equality sign between two colorings related by rotation, so rotations identify patterns. From the text, note that each of the 4 cells can be black or white. Count colorings fixed by each rotation of the square: identity fixes all 2^4 = 16 colorings; 90° and 270° rotations each fix only the all-same-on-four-cells patterns, giving 2 each; 180° rotation requires opposite cells equal, giving 2^2 = 4. Average over the 4 rotations: (16 + 2 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 6.

推理：一个 2×2 方格共有 4 个小方格，每个小方格可选黑或白。只考虑旋转等价，用 Burnside 引理计算旋转群下的不同涂色数。旋转群有 4 个元素：不旋转、旋转 90°、旋转 180°、旋转 270°。
不旋转固定所有涂色，共 2^4 = 16 种。
旋转 90° 后仍不变时，4 个小方格必须全同色，所以有 2 种。
旋转 180° 后仍不变时，对角位置必须相同，有两组对角位置可自由选择颜色，所以有 2^2 = 4 种。
旋转 270° 与旋转 90° 同理，也只有 2 种。
因此不同涂色数为 (16 + 2 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 6。
